# find_record

Say how many books or members match the name the request gives, and name them.

Source: `_commands/find_record.py`.

Calls: `find_book`, `find_member`.
Depth: 1 (lower bound; open steps name no command)

## Inputs

| input | type | default | sample | verify | in_request | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | required | `<name>` |  | yes | the name to look for |
| `kind` | one of book, member | `book` | `book` |  |  | whether the request is about a book or a member |

- `name` must be written in the request (`in_request`).

## Example requests

- do you have a book called Emma
- is there a member named Lee
